definitions.explanation: A type of mochi made by kneading mugwort (よもぎ) into glutinous rice dough, giving it a distinctive green color and herbal aroma. Often filled with sweet red bean paste. A traditional springtime confection.

examples.japanese: {草餅|くさもち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。

examples.english: When spring comes, mugwort rice cakes appear in the shops.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{摘|つ}んだ→摘む：02472_tsumu⟧⟦よもぎ→ヨモギ：11136_yomogi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{草餅|くさもち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother made mugwort rice cakes using mugwort she picked from the garden.

notes:
USAGE:
{草餅|くさもち} is a seasonal treat associated with ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧ (spring), when fresh ⟦よもぎ→ヨモギ：11136_yomogi⟧ (mugwort) is available. It is traditionally eaten around ⟦ひな{祭|まつ}り→ひな祭り：10517_hinamatsuri⟧ (Girls' Day, March 3). The ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧ in the name refers specifically to mugwort, not grass in general.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {草餅|くさもち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (make mugwort rice cakes)
- {草餅|くさもち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ (grill mugwort rice cakes)
- あんこ{入|い}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{草餅|くさもち} (mugwort rice cake with bean paste filling)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦よもぎ→ヨモギ：11136_yomogi⟧ is mugwort, the herb used to flavor the mochi.
- ⟦{大福|だいふく}→大福：12173_daifuku⟧ is a similar mochi confection filled with bean paste but without mugwort.
- ⟦{柏餅|かしわもち}→柏餅：19485_kashiwamochi⟧ is another seasonal mochi eaten during Boys' Day in May.
